# .agents

Operator task files, agent skills, and research artifacts.

## Purpose

- Task planning and execution records (Chain-of-Draft format).
- Agent skills for PQC secrets and signatures.
- Research JSON snapshots for catalog and model data.

## Ownership

- Maintained by operators using the local-router agent workflow.

## Local Contracts

- Task files must not contain secrets or keys.
- Chain-of-Draft requires each reasoning step to be ≤5 words.

## Work Guidance

- Follow `AGENTS.md` for task lifecycle and worktree rules.
- Read `llms.txt` before any edit.

## Verification

- Confirm `.agents/tasks/TASK.<date>.md` exists for active work.

## Child DOX Index

- [memories/llms.txt](memories/llms.txt) — Persistent repo memory graph and snapshot digest.
- [skills/pqc-secrets/llms.txt](skills/pqc-secrets/llms.txt) — PQC secrets skill.
- [skills/pqc-signatures-security/llms.txt](skills/pqc-signatures-security/llms.txt) — PQC signatures skill.
- [skills/repo-memory-graph-intelligence/SKILL.md](skills/repo-memory-graph-intelligence/SKILL.md) — Repo memory graph intelligence skill.
